# MLS listing photo preflight

> Free preflight check for MLS listing photos: resolution, file size, format, aspect ratio, branding filenames, and staged-photo pairing. Reads photo headers in your browser — nothing is uploaded. Download a dated evidence record before you deliver.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
